title: Workflow cancellation must accept UUIDT invocation IDs
answers: Why does the workflow run Cancel action fail with a validation error?
How should the cancellation API validate invocation_ids?
Can workflow cancellation accept UUIDTs as well as RFC UUIDs?
body:
Symptom: Cancelling a running workflow from the runs list or by direct API call fails with a validation error, and the run keeps going.
Root cause: nodejs/src/cdp/cdp-api.ts:CdpApi used version-aware UUID validation for invocation_ids, rejecting the UUIDTs issued by the invocation store.
Fix pattern: Validate identifiers against the issuer's format; cancellation uses UUID.validateString(id, false) to accept the 8-4-4-4-12 shape without requiring RFC version or variant bits.
Constraints: Applies to cancellation by invocation_ids. Keep malformed IDs rejected with 400 before calling cancelJobs, whose ::uuid[] bind would otherwise produce a database cast error surfaced as 500; this does not establish validation rules for unrelated UUID fields.
applies: CDP workflow invocation cancellation using the invocation_ids selector.
